# Hamster Hour

- Agent skill: https://hamsterhour.fun/SKILL.md
- Install: npx skills add https://hamsterhour.fun
- Discovery: https://hamsterhour.fun/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json
- ABI: https://hamsterhour.fun/abi/HamsterHour.json
- Deployment: https://hamsterhour.fun/imd-deployment.json
- Read-only API: https://hamsterhour.fun/api/window

Ethereum mainnet, own wallet only. Never handle private keys. Read SKILL.md for verification, spending limits and game rules.
